subject: Taxes
title: Offshore Cash Hoards
description: Learn Offshore Cash Hoards in one minute.

hook.text: By 2017, US companies held $2.6 trillion in profits offshore.

buildup.text: Apple alone held $252 billion overseas. Microsoft had $124 billion.

discovery.text: Companies lobbied for a 'repatriation holiday'—a temporary low rate to bring money home.

twist.text: Companies brought back $312 billion during the holiday.

climax.text: The 2017 tax law enacted a one-time 15.5% repatriation tax, ending the standoff.

punchline.text: $2.6 trillion trapped overseas. A broken system, fixed by cutting the rate.

quiz.question: How much did US companies hold offshore before the 2017 tax reform?
